verdict.rationale: Expensify publishes its app source in a public GitHub repo (Expensify/App), with build and run instructions (`npm install`, `npm run web`). That means the client source is readable and runnable locally. Nothing in the pack states which license applies, so the 'open license' part is unconfirmed, and the repo covers only the app client, not the whole product. Missing for 10: evidence of an OSI/open license on the repo, evidence that backend/server source is available, independent corroboration.
